effects.label: Deflection
effects.description: Redirects a percentage of all incoming damage from the recipient of the buff to the caster of the buff. The recipient takes the remainder of the damage as normal.

effects.label: Immunity
effects.description: Blocks Debuffs from being applied to the recipient.Immunity Buffs will not block Control Debuffs, and each Immunity buff will only negate a single Debuff before expiring. This buff can be stacked.

levels.text:
Attacks the 10 enemies with the lowest current HP in a 8.5m radius around Kryxa, from a distance of 4m, 2 times, dealing 144 damage per hit. The first hit casts an [Immunity] buff on Kryxa, lasting 10s, protecting the target against 3 debuffs. Casts a [20% Deflection] buff on the 10 allies with the lowest current HP in a 15m radius around Kryxa, lasting 10s, on the second hit. Targets under [Deflection] buffs will redirect 20% of all incoming damage onto the caster of the buff, while the target takes the remaining damage.

bio: After years working as a giant slayer-for-hire, Kryxa realized she was selling herself short. Her real destiny? Her own kingdom. So she set off, weapons in hand, to claim and plant her flag in as many lands as she could. She now proclaims to have 100 cantons under her control. No-one dare to disagree.
